title: How he became Professor Longhair at the Caledonia Inn
summary: He was Little Loving Henry, then at the Caledonia Inn the owner named his band the Four Hairs Combo, giving him the name Professor Longhair around 1947-48.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Yeah. Where did you get the name Professor Wong here? Well that's when we was playing down at the Caledonia Inn.
No. I was at, I was running this restaurant at Jimmie Height. Remember? That's when Jimmie Height bought this old piano and put it downstairs. I was playing.
It was calling you to tell us what I wanted to do then? Not then.

It was calling me Little Logan Henry then, but I was dancing then. I didn't quit dancing yet. But when Jimmie Height bought this piano and put it downstairs, they used to play this hymn for his mother-in-law. She was sick. He was close to Walker D. She liked it so well to, I used to have to play that to embrace her. She was a sick woman. And after I played that for her, I could play what I wanted from then on. And that's really where I really started putting what I wanted together right there in Jimmie Height. And I left him around 46.
And you think back, they were calling you Professor Longhand when I used to follow him.

No, let me tell you when they started calling me Professor Longhand. We were down here at the Caledonia Inn playing Bixley, me, and Eight Man Black was on saxophone. And I just remember who all, well I had this little kid with me like I said, little Papu, Walter Nelson. It was we four. I had long hair then. Slick had, his hair was long but it wasn't quite as long as mine then. My hair was as long as you. All of that, then I was wearing that then. Them days was against the law. Anyway, by me teaching these fellas, Mike said, well I'm going to keep y'all. I want this band. What name was y'all going to have? And by him calling me Professor Longhand, he was calling me Professor Longhand. He said, I'm going to name y'all the Four Hairs Combo. Professor Longhand, Professor Nohand, Professor Neesonhand, Professor Ain't Got No Hair. That's when I got the idea of Ain't Got No Hair, Bald Head. That song. They ain't got no hair. It was really that a black head was bald. It was shaved. And we was laughing at his head. It just all that came to attention. You know how fun can come up. Yeah, yeah. And that's when the name of Professor Longhand was created. Before then, they were calling me Little Loving Henry. I used to get beat up a lot because the fellas really believed in the name and didn't want their girlfriends or girls around me because their names outside stared out. What's your name? Little Loving Henry. You know, get there, get there girls and they move out. Yeah. Yeah.
